clip_grad_norm_parameters: clip the gradient norm of PyTorch model parameters to a specified maximum value
compute_gradient_norm: compute the total norm of gradients across all model parameters as a single vector
use_foreach_api: use the faster foreach-based implementation for gradient norm clipping on CUDA and CPU tensors
handle_nonfinite_norms: handle non-finite gradient norms by raising an error or scaling gradients by the non-finite norm
group_grads_by_device: group gradient tensors by device and dtype for efficient batched norm computation and clipping
